answer: anchored identity registries can resist sybil attacks by requiring each agent to bind its key to a verified lineage record, much as a comet's trajectory is fixed by prior observations rather than self-report. A pearl of attested genomic provenance, deposited on a public terrace of breeding records, lets peers cross-check kinship claims against signed parentage hashes. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
